top5.text: A Ninth Circuit panel split 2–1 to throw out DOJ's emergency bid over 20,000 California mail ballots; Judge Carter hears the case today.
Reuters: Washington and Ottawa are negotiating a narrow steel-and-autos tariff deal, possibly before 3 Nov.
A Senate committee voted to restore Poland's CIT rise to 22% and drop PIT-threshold indexation; the full Senate votes today.
Cyclone Arnab is due to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast by Oct 28; about 89,000 people are being evacuated.
Goyal says the India–US trade deal is mostly concluded and being fine-tuned; no signing date yet.

links.label: IANS / ANI (via The Tribune); Amar Ujala

US.text: A Ninth Circuit panel split 2-1 to dismiss DOJ's emergency bid to block about 20,000 California mail ballots, ruling it was premature because Judge Carter had not yet ruled. Carter's hearing is Oct 27.

Peltola's campaign and Senate Democrats asked Judge Sharon Gleason to dismiss DOJ's Alaska certification suit this week, calling it an unconstitutional intrusion. Blanche says Trump is not trying to take over the election.

CNN reports US forces could hit Iran within 96 hours of an order and that Trump refused Netanyahu's push for a pre-election strike. Qatari mediators were in Tehran, and Iran says indirect talks continue.

links.label: CNN via Times of Israel; CBS News

US.text: Reuters reports US and Canadian officials are negotiating a narrow deal to ease steel and auto tariffs, possibly before Nov 3, as Trump predicts the trade war will end 'soon'.
From Nov 3 every international air traveller to the US must sign a CDC attestation that they have not been in DR Congo in the past 21 days, because of the Ebola epidemic.
Anthropic filed publicly for a Nasdaq IPO, reporting $16.3bn first-half revenue. (This desk is produced with Anthropic's Claude.)

Poland.text: Tusk, in Hanoi, said Pełczyńska-Nałęcz's exit was 'for the best' and that a trusted non-partisan expert will run the funds ministry, sidestepping Hołownia's demand to keep the post.
A Senate committee backed restoring the CIT rise to 22% for the largest firms and scrapping PIT-threshold indexation; the full Senate is expected to vote on Tuesday.
Capped fuel prices rose for Tuesday, with diesel up 19 grosze to 8.18 zł/l under the government's 'Ceny Paliwa Niżej' package, which is expected to cost about 5bn zł through end-2026.
Poland and Vietnam upgraded ties to a strategic partnership in Hanoi, with a $6bn investment goal, talks on Krab and Rosomak arms sales, and LOT flights from 2027.
Sikorski accused Nawrocki of downplaying the Russian threat after the President said it had not changed drastically and accused the government of spreading fear.

About 4,000 Indians remain stranded in Saudi Arabia as Air India extends Riyadh/Dammam suspensions to Nov 7; no special evacuation flights yet.

rules.name: Exchange pre-eligibility verification (Working Families Tax Cut Act implementation)
rules.changes: Exchanges must verify eligibility before enrollment, and premium tax credits and cost-sharing reductions are generally withheld while data matches are unresolved.

rules.name: Order abolishing six City Hall departments (zarządzenie Prezydenta Miasta Krakowa)
rules.changes: Abolishes the departments of Civic Affairs, Kraków Brand, Sustainable Development, Municipal Services, Social Policy and Education, which were a management layer between the mayor and city offices.
rules.affects: City Hall staff and directors, and the reporting lines for ZTP, ZDMK, schools and social services.

rules.name: Outbound Investment Security Program rules (COINS Act)
rules.changes: Bans or requires notification of US investments in semiconductor, quantum, supercomputing, hypersonic, 'super intelligence' AI and biotechnology firms tied to China, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia; penalties up to IEEPA maximums, including forced divestment.
rules.affects: US investors, venture and private-equity funds, and US biotech and tech companies with Chinese partners.

rules.name: CDC order: Ebola travel attestation for all air passengers arriving in the US
rules.changes: Every international air passenger to or through the US must attest to no presence in DR Congo in the past 21 days; airlines must deny boarding without the attestation.
rules.affects: All international air travellers to the US, including from Poland and India, and airlines.

rules.name: Consumer Credit Directive 2 (CCD2)
rules.body: European Parliament and Council (Directive (EU) 2023/2225, CCD2); Polish implementing act not yet adopted
rules.changes: Brings many buy-now-pay-later, interest-free and small loans under full consumer-credit rules.
rules.affects: Borrowers, payday lenders, BNPL providers, online shops and banks in Poland.

rules.name: Act on the tax on extraordinary profits of fuel companies ('Ceny Paliwa Niżej' package)
rules.changes: Allows temporary cuts to VAT and excise on fuels and daily maximum retail prices set by the energy minister.
rules.affects: All drivers and fuel buyers, fuel companies and stations, and the public finances (about 5bn zł).

deepDive.title: Expensive oil, tight money and tariff bargains
deepDive.body:
The common thread across all three countries today is a Gulf-war oil price that is now feeding into budgets, rates and trade talks. Brent sat around $114–115 on 26 Oct (Confirmed), roughly double what it was before the Iran conflict.

**US.** The Fed opens its two-day meeting today with the funds rate at 3.75–4.00%. Futures price a hold on 28 Oct but roughly three-in-four odds of a December hike after September CPI hit 3.7% (Reported, [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-oct-26-2026)). On trade, the administration is fighting on two fronts. Reuters reports a possible narrow deal with Canada on Section 232 steel and auto tariffs, while the revised Section 338 list still takes effect 30 Oct.

**Poland.** Warsaw is paying to shield drivers: fuel price caps funded by a 60% windfall tax on fuel companies, with diesel back above 8 zł/l. Meanwhile the Senate committee's move to restore the CIT rise and drop PIT indexation shows the finance ministry prioritising revenue. The RPP decision on 4 Nov will show whether oil-driven inflation delays rate cuts.

**India.** The rupee at about 95 to the dollar and heavy foreign outflows are the oil shock's local face; the RBI is reportedly selling dollars (Reported). New Delhi is leaning on trade deals for a growth story: Goyal says the EU FTA could be signed by year-end and the US deal is in final fine-tuning.

**What to watch:** the Fed on 28 Oct, Poland's flash CPI on 30 Oct, and whether either the US–Canada or US–India deal gets a date.
